-- 004_seed_demo.sql
-- Dataset demo > 50 registros, idempotente en catálogos.
-- Si necesitas volver a cargar operativo desde cero, TRUNCATE antes.

-- ===== IDs FIJOS =====
-- Tenant y contexto
WITH ids AS (
  SELECT
    '10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid AS tenant_id,
    '10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000010'::uuid AS camp_2526,
    '10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000011'::uuid AS est_las_lomas,
    '10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000012'::uuid AS est_santa_ana
)
INSERT INTO core.tenant (id, name)
SELECT tenant_id, 'Agro Sur SA' FROM ids
ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;

INSERT INTO ref.currency (id, code, name) VALUES
('20000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001','USD','Dolar estadounidense'),
('20000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002','ARS','Peso argentino')
ON CONFLICT (code) DO NOTHING;

('21000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001','kg','Kilogramo','mass'),
('21000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002','ha','Hectarea','area'),
('21000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003','l','Litro','volume'),
('21000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004','kg_ha','Kilogramo por hectarea','rate'),
('21000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000005','l_ha','Litro por hectarea','rate')
ON CONFLICT (code) DO NOTHING;

-- 10 movimientos
INSERT INTO inv.inventory_movement (id, tenant_id, stock_lot_id, movement_type, moved_at, qty, unit_cost, ref_doc_type, ref_doc_id)
SELECT
  gen_random_uuid(),
  '10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
  CASE
    WHEN i <= 2 THEN '14100000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid
    WHEN i <= 4 THEN '14100000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'::uuid
    WHEN i <= 6 THEN '14100000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003'::uuid
    WHEN i <= 8 THEN '14100000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004'::uuid
    ELSE '14100000-0000-0000-0000-000000000005'::uuid
  END,
  CASE WHEN i % 2 = 0 THEN 'out' ELSE 'in' END,
  now() - (i || ' days')::interval,
  100 + i * 5,
  1.00 + i * 0.01,
  'seed_demo',
  NULL
FROM generate_series(1,10) AS s(i);

-- Series satelitales: 4 lotes x 12 fechas = 48 filas
INSERT INTO geo.spectral_index_daily (
  id, tenant_id, plot_id, index_type, observed_date, mean_value, p10_value, p90_value, stddev_value
)
SELECT
  gen_random_uuid(),
  '10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
  p.plot_id,
  'NDVI',
  d.obs_date,
  (0.45 + (row_number() OVER () % 20) * 0.01)::numeric(8,5),
  0.32,
  0.71,
  0.08
FROM (
  VALUES
  ('11000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid),
  ('11000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'::uuid),
  ('11000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003'::uuid),
  ('11000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004'::uuid)
) p(plot_id)
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT ('2025-09-01'::date + (g * 10)) AS obs_date
  FROM generate_series(0,11) g
) d
ON CONFLICT (plot_id, index_type, observed_date) DO NOTHING;
